summary: Backend-only authorization retest: all 18 existing tests pass, including all five prior failures. Two supplemental OCR regressions also pass, covering read/review/download denial for pending and nonmember doctors, consent scope enforcement, revocation, and UTC expiry persistence. No product code changed.
action_items: No blocking action for the requested authorization fixes. Broader previously reported auth and adjacent-route concerns were outside this retest and are not cleared by these results.
test_credentials: Read documented credentials and auth instructions before testing. Existing documented patient/doctor/admin accounts authenticated without modification. Isolated TEST_ accounts used for clinical checks; documented admin used only to approve and organize those accounts.
seed_data_creation: No seed/reset/migration. Each suite used disposable TEST_ accounts, organization, membership, consents and records. Synthetic appointments and OCR documents/files were inserted only for isolated authorization testing. Cleanup removed only captured test-owned IDs; clinical fixture cleanup assertions passed. Normal audit events retained. No APIs MOCKED; no LLM, OAuth, calendar or object-storage integration invoked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Source frontend/.env then run the two linked pytest files with JUnit output. All HTTP requests use public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Existing regression ran in 18.54 seconds; supplemental suite ran in 11.13 seconds. Prior expired +10:00 consent bypass now denies, valid future -10:00 consent permits access, naive expiry returns validation error, pending appointment doctor OCR read denies, and nonmember enriched appointment queue denies. Supplemental tests additionally deny OCR read/approved-review/download for both lab reports and prescriptions when pending/nonmember doctors have BOTH appointment and matching consent; document remains pending and no EMR record is created. Verified member with records-only consent is denied OCR; matching labs/prescriptions scope permits document read and rejection review with persisted state. Revocation then denies read/review/download. Supplemental test verifies offset expiry is returned and stored in UTC without changing the instant. Successful binary download was not attempted because external object storage is outside scope; only authorization rejection was tested. Product files were reviewed, not modified. Prior baseline auth lockout/cookie and broader adjacent-route issues were not retested. Available finish tool substitutes for unavailable test_finish.
rca of the issue: Reviewed fixes remove lexical expiry comparisons: aware timestamps are normalized to UTC on grant and compared as actual instants by central access. Naive timestamps are rejected before comparison. OCR delegates to central scope-aware chart policy, enforcing approval and active membership before appointment fallback. Doctor appointment queue now enforces the same professional eligibility before querying/enriching clinical data. All five preceding failures are resolved in this executed regression.
